name: rigorium-method
description: Rigorium theory and method implementation boundary: executable method specifications, isolated verification, and read-only implementation snapshots.

capabilities: Turn a ready research brief into an executable, cross-referenced method specification.
Describe mathematical definitions, assumptions, procedures, complexity, counterexamples, and failure boundaries.
Run unit, numerical, and smoke checks in a workspace separate from the user project.
Capture source, test, and configuration hashes without writing to or committing the user worktree.
Keep expected conclusions separate from conclusions supported by verification records.
